<style>
/* ── Dashboard-specific styles ── */
.db-wrap { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 32px 60px; }

/* Section headers */
.db-section-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  margin: 36px 0 18px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e8eaed;
}
.db-section-head .icon { font-size: 1.2rem; }
.db-section-head h2 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin: 0; }
.db-section-head .sub { font-size: 12px; color: #6b7280; margin-left: auto; }

/* KPI strip */
.kpi-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6,1fr); gap: 1px; background: #e8eaed; border: 1px solid #e8eaed; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.kpi { background: #fff; padding: 18px 14px; text-align: center; cursor: default; transition: background .15s; }
.kpi:hover { background: #f9fafb; }
.kpi-n { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
.kpi-l { font-size: 10px; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-top: 5px; }

/* Nav pills for sections */
.dash-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 24px 0 6px; }
.dash-nav button {
  padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #e8eaed;
  background: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6b7280;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; font-family: inherit;
}
.dash-nav button.on { background: #1a1a2e; color: #c9a84c; border-color: #1a1a2e; }
.dash-nav button:hover:not(.on) { border-color: #1a1a2e; color: #1a1a2e; }
.dash-panel { display: none; }
.dash-panel.on { display: block; }

/* Two-col grid */
.d2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.d3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.d-full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

/* White card */
.dc { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e8eaed; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; }
.dc-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .5px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.dc-title span { font-weight: 400; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 11px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }

/* Dark card */
.dc-dark { background: #0f1117; border: 1px solid #1e2030; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; }
.dc-dark .dc-title { color: #fff; }

/* Bar chart rows */
.br { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 9px; }
.br-l { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; width: 130px; flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.br-l.lt { color: #9ca3af; }
.br-t { flex: 1; background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 3px; height: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.br-t.dk { background: #1e2030; }
.br-f { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; width: 0; transition: width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }
.br-v { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; width: 46px; text-align: right; color: #1a1a2e; }
.br-v.lt { color: #fff; }

/* Metric mini */
.mmi { background: #0f1117; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; text-align: center; }
.mmi-n { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; color: #c9a84c; line-height: 1.1; }
.mmi-l { font-size: 10px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 4px; }
.mmi-sub { font-size: 10px; color: #4b5563; margin-top: 2px; }

/* Confusion matrix */
.cm { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; }
.cmh { font-size: 10px; color: #9ca3af; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; }
.cmh.rh { text-align: right; padding-right: 10px; font-size: 9px; }
.cmc { padding: 16px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; }
.tp { background: rgba(29,158,117,.22); color: #065f46; }
.tn { background: rgba(55,138,221,.18); color: #1e40af; }
.fp { background: rgba(226,75,74,.14); color: #991b1b; }
.fn { background: rgba(226,75,74,.14); color: #991b1b; }

/* Progress ring */
.ring-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.ring-label { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; text-align: center; }

/* Table */
.dt { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
.dt th { background: #1a1a2e; color: #c9a84c; padding: 9px 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600; }
.dt td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; color: #374151; }
.dt tr:hover td { background: #fafafa; }
.bge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.bg-g { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
.bg-b { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
.bg-r { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
.bg-gr { background: #f3f4f6; color: #6b7280; }

/* Finding row */
.fr { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; }
.fr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.fr-icon { font-size: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
.fr-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.fr-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.5; }

/* Insight pill cards */
.ip { border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; border-left: 3px solid; }
.ip-g { background: #f0fdf4; border-color: #1D9E75; }
.ip-b { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #378ADD; }
.ip-y { background: #fffbeb; border-color: #c9a84c; }
.ip-s { background: #f9fafb; border-color: #374151; }
.ip-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ip-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #374151; line-height: 1.55; }

/* Radar-style score display */
.score-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.score-name { font-size: 12px; color: #374151; width: 160px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.score-bar { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
.score-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; width: 0; transition: width 1.2s; }
.score-val { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; width: 42px; text-align: right; }

/* Genre revenue bars */
.gbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.gbar-name { font-size: 11px; color: #374151; width: 160px; flex-shrink: 0; font-weight: 500; }
.gbar-t { flex: 1; background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 3px; height: 14px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.gbar-f { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; width: 0; transition: width 1.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding-right: 6px; }
.gbar-v { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Budget tier visual */
.tier-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr 60px 60px 60px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; font-size: 12px; }
.tier-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.tier-badge { border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.tier-bar-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.tier-bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; width: 0; transition: width 1.2s; }

/* Step workflow */
.wf { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); gap: 12px; }
.wf-step { background: #f9fafb; border: 1px solid #e8eaed; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 14px; text-align: center; position: relative; }
.wf-num { width: 30px; height: 30px; background: #1a1a2e; color: #c9a84c; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; margin: 0 auto 10px; }
.wf-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.wf-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.5; }

/* Country ranking */
.ctr { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f5f5f5; }
.ctr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.ctr-rank { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #c9a84c; width: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ctr-name { font-size: 12px; color: #374151; flex: 1; }
.ctr-bar-t { width: 80px; background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 2px; height: 6px; }
.ctr-bar-f { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: #1D9E75; width: 0; transition: width 1.2s; }
.ctr-val { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; width: 28px; text-align: right; }

/* Donut SVG */
.donut-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 10px; }

/* Member card */
.mc { background: #12121e; border: 1px solid #1e2030; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; text-align: center; }
.mc-av { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 auto 8px; }
.mc-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.mc-role { font-size: 10px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 2px; }
.mc-qs { font-size: 10px; color: #c9a84c; margin-top: 4px; }

/* Limitation item */
.lim { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; }
.lim:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.lim-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 5px; }
.lim-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.lim-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.5; }

/* Responsive */
@media(max-width:768px){
  .kpi-strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .d2,.d3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .wf{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .db-wrap{padding:16px 16px 40px}
}
</style>

     PANEL 1 — OVERVIEW

<div class="dash-panel on" id="p-overview">

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">🎯</span><h2>Central Research Question</h2></div>
  <div style="background:#1a1a2e;border-radius:12px;padding:28px 32px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px">
    <p style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:.9rem;font-style:italic;max-width:700px;margin:0 auto 18px;line-height:1.8">"Which movie characteristics best explain and predict a movie's success in terms of audience evaluation and financial performance?"</p>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center">
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">Genre matters for revenue</span>
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">Budget predicts scale</span>
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">log_votes dominates rating</span>
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">Star power → visibility</span>
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">Ensembles always win</span>
      <span style="padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;color:#c9a84c">Success is multidimensional</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">🔁</span><h2>Data Science Workflow</h2></div>
  <div class="wf" style="margin-bottom:20px">
    <div class="wf-step"><div class="wf-num">1</div><div class="wf-title">Load &amp; Clean</div><div class="wf-desc">Parsed votes (K/M), duration (min), money fields, genres, dates from raw text across 63,249 records</div></div>
    <div class="wf-step"><div class="wf-num">2</div><div class="wf-title">Describe</div><div class="wf-desc">Grouped summaries, visualisations across countries, genres, runtime, budget tiers and revenue</div></div>
    <div class="wf-step"><div class="wf-num">3</div><div class="wf-title">Model</div><div class="wf-desc">Train/test splits, feature selection, Ridge, Extra Trees, Gradient Boosting and Random Forest compared</div></div>
    <div class="wf-step"><div class="wf-num">4</div><div class="wf-title">Evaluate</div><div class="wf-desc">MAE, RMSE, R², ROC AUC, F1, confusion matrices, feature importances reported per question</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">💡</span><h2>6 Key Findings</h2></div>
  <div class="d2">
    <div>
      <div class="ip ip-g" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="ip-title">🌍 Country Shapes Ratings</div><div class="ip-desc">Smaller, selective industries show higher averages. Larger ones (US) show greater variation — prestige films alongside mass-market productions.</div></div>
      <div class="ip ip-b" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="ip-title">🎭 Genre: Ratings ≠ Votes</div><div class="ip-desc">Documentary and biopic genres earn high ratings with small audiences. Action and franchise genres drive massive vote counts regardless of rating.</div></div>
      <div class="ip ip-y"><div class="ip-title">⏱️ Non-linear Runtime Effect</div><div class="ip-desc">Films between 90–140 min cluster at the highest ratings. Very short or very long films show far more variability in audience reception.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="ip ip-s" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="ip-title">💰 Budget Predicts Revenue (Imperfectly)</div><div class="ip-desc">Pearson r=0.685. High-budget films: 65.3% profitable. Low-budget: 39.2%. ROI outliers dominate in both directions.</div></div>
      <div class="ip ip-g" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="ip-title">⭐ Star Power → Visibility, Not Quality</div><div class="ip-desc">Well-known personnel reliably boost vote counts, but median ratings are identical (6.30) for high-profile and low-profile groups.</div></div>
      <div class="ip ip-b"><div class="ip-title">🤖 Ensemble Methods Dominate</div><div class="ip-desc">Random Forest, Extra Trees and Gradient Boosting consistently outperformed Ridge/Linear baselines on all 6 ML prediction tasks.</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">📈</span><h2>Model Performance Summary</h2><span class="sub">All best models per task</span></div>
  <div class="d3">
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">0.365</div><div class="mmi-l">R² — Rating prediction</div><div class="mmi-sub">Gradient Boosting</div></div>
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">0.645</div><div class="mmi-l">R² — Revenue prediction</div><div class="mmi-sub">Gradient Boosting</div></div>
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">87.3%</div><div class="mmi-l">ROC AUC — High-rating</div><div class="mmi-sub">Random Forest</div></div>
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">70.0%</div><div class="mmi-l">Accuracy — Success class.</div><div class="mmi-sub">Random Forest</div></div>
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">0.606</div><div class="mmi-l">R² — Vote count</div><div class="mmi-sub">Random Forest</div></div>
    <div class="mmi"><div class="mmi-n">0.484</div><div class="mmi-l">R² — Release timing</div><div class="mmi-sub">Decision Tree</div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
     PANEL 2 — DESCRIPTIVE
══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div class="dash-panel" id="p-descriptive">

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">🌍</span><h2>Q1 — Ratings by Country</h2><span class="sub">Kay-Lee Dramat</span></div>
  <div class="d2">
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Top 10 countries by average rating</div>
      <div id="country-bars"></div>
      <p style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f0;padding-top:8px">Smaller industries rank higher due to curation bias — only the best films gain international visibility.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Key insight <span>country analysis</span></div>
      <div class="fr"><span class="fr-icon">📌</span><div><div class="fr-title">Selection bias effect</div><div class="fr-desc">Countries with fewer releases in the dataset show inflated averages — their weaker films never appear.</div></div></div>
      <div class="fr"><span class="fr-icon">🇺🇸</span><div><div class="fr-title">US: most variable</div><div class="fr-desc">Largest industry shows widest rating spread — from Oscar-winners to mass-market releases in the same dataset.</div></div></div>
      <div class="fr"><span class="fr-icon">🥇</span><div><div class="fr-title">Iran ranks first</div><div class="fr-desc">Iranian cinema (Farhadi etc.) gains global attention primarily through critically acclaimed films.</div></div></div>
      <div class="fr"><span class="fr-icon">🇮🇳</span><div><div class="fr-title">India #8 despite volume</div><div class="fr-desc">Despite being the world's largest film industry by output, only internationally visible titles appear here.</div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">🎭</span><h2>Q2 — Genre Performance</h2><span class="sub">Kay-Lee Dramat</span></div>
  <div class="d2">
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Top genres by average rating</div>
      <div id="genre-rating-bars"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Top genres by worldwide revenue <span>avg $M</span></div>
      <div id="genre-rev-bars"></div>
      <p style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f0;padding-top:8px">Rating ≠ Revenue. Documentary genres top rating charts; action genres dominate box office.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="db-section-head"><span class="icon">⏱️</span><h2>Q3 — Runtime Effect</h2><span class="sub">Kay-Lee Dramat</span></div>
  <div class="d2">
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Rating distribution by runtime bucket</div>
      <div id="runtime-bars"></div>
      <p style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f0;padding-top:8px">90–140 min is the sweet spot. Outside this range, quality becomes highly variable.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="dc">
      <div class="dc-title">Runtime facts</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px">
        <div style="background:#f9fafb;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;text-align:center"><div style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;color:#1a1a2e">80–150</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:3px">Most common range (min)</div></div>

          <tr><td>Extra Trees</td><td>1.549</td><td>2.045</td><td>0.630</td><td>$27M</td><td><span class="bge bg-b">Good</span></td></tr>

<script>
/* ── KPI counters ── */
function animCount(id, end, suffix, dec) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  let s = 0, inc = end / 60;
  const t = setInterval(() => {
    s += inc; if (s >= end) { s = end; clearInterval(t); }
    el.textContent = (dec ? s.toFixed(3) : Math.round(s)) + suffix;
  }, 20);
}
setTimeout(() => {
  animCount('k1', 63249, '', false);
  animCount('k2', 12, '', false);
  animCount('k3', 87, '%', false);
  animCount('k4', 0.645, '', true);
  animCount('k5', 86, '%', false);
  animCount('k6', 7, '', false);
}, 300);

/* ── Bar animation ── */
function animBars() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-w]').forEach(el => {
    el.style.width = el.dataset.w + '%';
  });
}
setTimeout(animBars, 700);

/* ── Panel navigation ── */
function switchPanel(id, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dash-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('on'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('on'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('on');
  btn.classList.add('on');
  setTimeout(animBars, 100);
}

/* ── Model tabs ── */
function switchMTab(id, btn) {
  ['mt1','mt2','mt3','mt4','mt5','mt6'].forEach(x => {
    const el = document.getElementById(x);
    if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#mtabs button').forEach(b => {
    b.style.background = '#fff'; b.style.color = '#6b7280'; b.style.borderColor = '#e8eaed';
  });
  document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'block';
  btn.style.background = '#1a1a2e'; btn.style.color = '#c9a84c'; btn.style.borderColor = '#1a1a2e';
  setTimeout(animBars, 100);
}

/* ── Dynamic bar builders ── */
function buildBars(containerId, data, colorFn) {
  const c = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!c) return;
  c.innerHTML = data.map(([label, val, max, color]) => `
    <div class="br">
      <span class="br-l" style="width:160px;font-size:11px">${label}</span>
      <div class="br-t"><div class="br-f" data-w="${Math.round(val/max*100)}" style="background:${color};width:0"></div></div>
      <span class="br-v" style="font-size:11px">${typeof val === 'number' && val > 10 ? val : val}</span>
    </div>`).join('');
}
